title: How to calculate the next birthday (or anniversary) date
task: From a birthdate, find when the next birthday falls — reminders, HR sheets, countdowns.

excel.note: A2 = birthdate. Whole years lived so far, plus one, in months — EDATE lands on the next anniversary.

explanation: DATEDIF counts completed years (34 for a Feb 1992 birthdate as of July 2026); adding one and converting to months lets EDATE jump from the birthdate straight to the NEXT anniversary — February 10, 2027. Because DATEDIF increments exactly on the anniversary, the formula rolls over correctly on the day itself. Days until it: subtract TODAY(). Leap-day birthdays (Feb 29) land on Feb 28 in common years via EDATE's clamping.
